title.en: Control of Vectors and Pesticides (Registration of Pesticides and Vector Repellents) Regulations 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Control of Vectors and Pesticides (Registration of Pesticides and Vector Repellents) Regulations 2023 and come into operation on 1 September 2023.

3.—(1) For the purpose of section 6(a) of the Act, the prescribed fee is —
(a)where the application is for the registration of a pesticide — $320; and
[S 138/2026 wef 01/04/2026]
(b)where the application is for the registration of a vector repellent — $320.
[S 138/2026 wef 01/04/2026]
(2) Any fee paid under paragraph (1) is not refundable.
